span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Conscious access happens because a temporally deep level of the hierarchy infers and integrates lower-level states over a slow enough timescale to contextualise them and drive extended report behaviour.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Late ERPs arise because the ERP is the time derivative of the depolarisation variable, so a rapid change in high-level belief produces a large late deflection.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Rapid belief change increases the magnitude of the depolarisation derivative, which is what makes a late component appear.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Expectations act by raising second-level posterior confidence, which magnifies top-down feedback to sensory populations and pushes marginal trials past the ignition threshold.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Scope deliberately restricted to settings where visual consciousness is operationalised by report.
span.note: what this limits: every prediction the model makes: WE HAVE DELIBERATELY LIMITED THE SCOPE OF THE MODEL TO EXPERIMENTAL SETTINGS WHERE VISUAL CONSCIOUSNESS IS OPERATIONALISED VIA REPORT
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Report paradigms themselves carry known methodological problems.
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0, with the cost: REPORT PARADIGMS COME WITH METHODOLOGICAL DIFFICULTIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Restricting the model to vision perpetuates the visual bias of consciousness science.
span.note: what this limits: the modality the theory has been tested in, and what that does to the field: IN LIMITING THE SCOPE OF THE PGNW TO THE VISUAL MODALITY, WE ARE AWARE THAT WE ARE REIFYING THE PERVASIVE BIAS IN CONSCIOUSNESS SCIENCE OF PRIMARILY STUDYING VISION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The match to the four-way taxonomy is partly built in, since parameters were tuned to the published behavioural results.
span.note: what this limits: the model's match to the four-way taxonomy, which is not independent confirmation: THIS SHOULD NOT BE A SURPRISE, AS WE FINETUNED THE PARAMETER VALUES TO CAPTURE BEHAVIOUR REPORTED IN THE EMPIRICAL LITERATURE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The model cannot represent partial awareness, because information cannot skip hierarchical levels in it.
span.note: what this limits: any account of partial awareness: THIS REQUIRES INFORMATION TO SKIP LEVELS OF THE HIERARCHY, WHICH IS ALSO NOT POSSIBLE IN THE PRESENT MODEL
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Simulated report frequencies are only directional, not quantitative, predictions.
span.note: what this limits: the simulated report frequencies: THEY SHOULD BE INTERPRETED AS DIRECTIONAL HYPOTHESES, AS OPPOSED TO PRECISE PREDICTIONS ABOUT THE PERCENTAGE OF SEEN VS UNSEEN TRIALS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Two predictions of the theory this paper extends are stated to have been falsified.
span.note: what this limits: any appeal to the original global neuronal workspace formulation: the authors state that as experimental paradigms became more sophisticated, two of its predictions have been falsified
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The falsifying result is qualified inline by whether its instrument is a fair proxy.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that information is unconsciously maintained by the same structures: the authors qualify it as holding at least briefly and insofar as multivariate decoding is a defensible proxy for information processing
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The P3 is reported to track task relevance rather than conscious access.
span.note: what this limits: any use of the P3 as a signature of conscious access: a masking-paradigm replication is stated to show unequivocally that Quotation withheld
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A marker was abandoned without any accompanying theoretical revision, which the authors name as a degenerative pattern.
span.note: what this limits: any reading of the GNW's response to the P3 findings: the abandonment of the P3 as a signature of conscious access was not accompanied by any theoretical revisions and makes no additional behavioural or neurobiological predictions
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The replacement model offered for the falsified one is stated to be too idealised for neurobiological predictions.
span.note: what this limits: any neurobiological prediction attributed to the revised computational model of subjective report: the authors state it is too idealised to make them
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Where phenomenology sits in the model was chosen to avoid an empirically unfalsifiable consequence.
span.note: what this limits: the model's placement of phenomenology: the alternative would make the presence of a particular phenomenology empirically unfalsifiable, and the authors state they situate it as they do to avoid that conclusion
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A parameter that empirical work fits to data was fixed by assumption, and it affects the predicted ERPs.
span.note: what this limits: any ERP predicted by these simulations: the decay parameter that in empirical work needs to be fit to neuronal or behavioural responses was set to 1 here, and the authors state predicted ERPs can be affected by different values of it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: With one consistent parameter set the simulated agent reproduced the GNW four-way taxonomy behaviourally: weak signal plus absent attention gave chance forced-choice performance and almost no 'seen' reports.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Simulated first-level ERPs, corresponding to early components such as P100 and N100, barely changed with visibility.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Simulated second-level ERPs, corresponding to the late P3, were strongly modulated by visibility, matching the empirical early-versus-late ERP dissociation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The model reproduced the Pitts inattentional-blindness dissociation: only in phase three, when the square was both seen and task-relevant, did a large late P3-like ERP appear.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The model yields the testable prediction that a late ERP accompanies conscious access only when high-level confidence shifts quickly, so awareness without a P3 is possible.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Adding prior expectation as a third factor, expectations consistent with the stimulus raised both forced-choice accuracy and the rate of 'seen' reports in every quadrant of the taxonomy.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: With a strong attended stimulus, a consistent prior shrank the simulated P3 while an inconsistent prior enlarged it relative to neutral priors.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The model reconciles univariate ignition results with multivariate decoding of unseen stimuli, because above-baseline firing persists on unconscious trials and would be readable by a classifier even though mean rates are lower.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
